meta.description: Custom web and mobile development, cloud deployment, artificial intelligence, IoT, mechanical and 3D design. Walk through our virtual office.

portada.lead: We take your idea from the screen to the real world: we build software, artificial intelligence and connected devices, and we design the parts and 3D models that make them possible. All with one team.

items.texto: We build everything from landing pages to advanced web platforms with APIs, databases and background jobs, designed and coded around your business.
lista: Landing pages and corporate sites ready for search engines
Custom web applications and admin dashboards
APIs, databases and integrations with your systems
Background events and jobs: emails, reports and syncs
Online stores and interactive 3D experiences, like this office
items.nota: We hand over the source code and the complete project. The code is yours: we never keep ownership of it.

items.texto: We build mobile apps for Android and iOS, from simple apps that showcase your brand to advanced apps with APIs, databases and background jobs.
lista: Informational and catalog apps for your brand
Custom apps connected to your API and database
Notifications, syncing and background jobs
Support to publish on Google Play and the App Store
items.nota: We hand over the source code and the complete project. The code is yours: we never keep ownership of it.

items.texto: We put your application online and keep it running smoothly: we set up servers, domains and databases in the cloud so your project is available, secure and ready to grow.
lista: Servers, domains and SSL certificates
Cloud databases and storage
Automatic deployment on every change (CI/CD)
Monitoring, backups and scaling on demand

items.texto: We put AI to work in your operations: from automations and custom assistants to data analysis, predictive models and neural networks trained for your case.
lista: AI-powered automation of processes, tasks and documents
Personal assistants and chatbots that know your company's information
Data analysis and predictive models
Custom neural networks and computer vision

items.texto: From sensor to dashboard: we build the hardware, firmware and platform so you can monitor and control your equipment in real time, from anywhere.
lista: Device prototypes with sensors and actuators
Firmware for microcontrollers
Cloud monitoring dashboards and alerts
Integration with your existing systems and equipment

items.texto: We model products, spaces and parts in 3D to present, validate and manufacture them: from renders for your catalog to interactive experiences on your website.
lista: Modeling and rendering of products and spaces
Interactive 3D scenes for the web
Models ready for 3D printing
Animations and virtual tours

items.texto: We design parts and mechanisms with engineering judgment, validate them and deliver drawings and prototypes ready for production.
lista: CAD design of parts, assemblies and mechanisms
Manufacturing drawings and technical specifications
Design analysis and validation
Rapid prototyping with 3D printing

items.texto: This very website: a 3D office you can walk through in the browser, with a guided camera, animated characters that walk around the furniture, and sections that open when you click on objects.
lista: Modeling, texturing and lighting of the whole office
Animated characters that find their way around the furniture
Optimized to load and run in the browser
Navigation with clicks, scrolling and the keyboard

items.texto: An IoT service that monitors the weather of rural communities in real time and supports the management of their infrastructure projects. A weather station sends its readings to a cloud API, and a web platform turns them into maps, alerts, history and reports. It works as an add-on layer to the SARA system, without affecting the rest of it.
lista: Ecowitt weather station connected via webhook: wind, rain, UV radiation, temperature and humidity
REST API with Django and background processing with Celery and Redis: no reading is ever lost
React web platform with a station map, alerts, zone comparison and PDF and CSV reports
Three roles with their own permissions: administrator, community operator and external consultant
Deployed on AWS and tested: 1,510 requests without errors, with responses under 140 ms (p95)

items.texto: Landing page for Briggith Guzmán's therapy practice in Bucaramanga: it presents her therapies, video testimonials, podcast and location, and leads visitors to book through WhatsApp. It is built to show up on Google, load fast on any phone and turn visits into appointments.
lista: Technical SEO: local business structured data, sitemap, Open Graph and clean URLs
Speed: pre-rendered HTML, AVIF and WebP images in several sizes, and videos and a map that load only when used
Measurement with Google Analytics and continuous improvement based on the data
Video testimonials, podcast and social media built in
Direct booking through WhatsApp, contact form and light and dark mode

items.texto: Online store for lingerie, wellness products and accessories in Colombia. The catalog can be filtered by category and search, each product opens its gallery with price and stock, and the buy button takes you to WhatsApp with the order ready to send.
lista: Catalog with category filters, search and a detail view with a photo gallery
Purchase through WhatsApp with the order message already written
Products managed from a spreadsheet: they update without touching the code
Visible stock, low-stock notices and sold-out products
SEO, speed and measurement with Google Analytics for continuous improvement

items.texto: Mobile app to book and keep track of personal care appointments: nails, lashes, haircuts, barbering, massages or facials. It has two sides: a marketplace where clients discover and book, and a management tool for the people who provide the service, whether freelancers or salons with a team and several locations.
lista: Book in a few taps: open time slots, request, confirmation and counter-offers
Professional's calendar, manual bookings and time blocking
Public profile with portfolio, reviews and search filtered by price, day and rating
Businesses with teams, locations, payments, earnings and payouts
Promotions for off-peak hours and content moderation

items.texto: An app to organize events and sell their tickets end to end: the organizer creates the event, defines the ticket types and builds a team; attendees buy, receive a QR ticket and can transfer it; and at the door the staff validates every entry with the scanner.
lista: Organizations, events and staff teams with per-event permissions
Checkout with temporary ticket holds, promo codes and buyer questions
QR tickets, companions and one-time transfers
Scanner at the entrance and a cash desk for cash payments
Guest list with approvals

items.texto: An app for fashion designers and design houses: each designer builds a professional profile with their specialty and location, works as a freelancer or as a design house, and creates garments from a sketch, a template or a photo.
lista: Designer sign-up and profile with photo, specialties and background
Design houses with their members, or freelance work
Product creation from a sketch, a template or a photo
Garment catalog with categories, parts, colors, prints and fits
In Spanish and English, with light and dark mode

items.texto: A field app to manage the construction of solar farms. The field engineer reports the progress of each activity with quantities, location and evidence; the quality engineer approves or returns each report; and management follows the progress of every project. It forms a single system with the web console.
lista: Progress by activity: pile driving, bolting, beam and panel mounting, wiring and pull-out tests
Field report with executed quantity, layout location (inverter, string, table and panel), shift and photo and GPS evidence
Quality inbox to approve or return each report
Overall progress tracking for each project
Three roles with their own view: field engineer, quality engineer and administrator

items.conjunto: Part of Solar site control, together with the mobile app
items.texto: The administration console of the same system. From the browser you manage projects, work teams, rented machinery, alerts and the audit trail of the whole operation, with certified progress against the plan.
lista: Dashboard with certified progress against the plan, weekly pace and estimated completion
Projects with progress by activity, assigned team and machinery
Team, role permissions and access requests
Rented machinery with contracts, maintenance and logbook
Field reports, alerts, messages and an audit trail of every change

tecnologias.texto: These are the technologies we work with every day. We choose the combination each project needs.

grupos.texto: Web interfaces with Angular and React, and mobile apps with React Native and Flutter.
Python with Django, Flask and FastAPI; Java with Spring Boot and Quarkus; plus Go and Node.js.
Relational and document databases, with Redis as a cache database.
We mainly deploy on AWS and DigitalOcean, and use Vercel for landing pages.
Custom devices connected to custom software.
LLMs to speed up work, n8n for automations, statistical models for data analysis, and neural networks.

Web development, from the interface to the database

Programming consulting and private tutoring in software and systems

lista: CAD modeling of parts and mechanisms
3D printing of prototypes and final parts
Product rendering and visualization
Prototypes with sensors and microcontrollers
Firmware and wireless connectivity
Monitoring and control from the cloud
